candidate.description: STI bank selloff stole the spotlight this week. The STI bank selloff dominated the week in Singapore, with the index sliding about 4.1% to 5,401.89 as OCBC, UOB and DBS tumbled on Wednesday and Thursday. The trigger was global: the US 10-year Treasury yield hit 5.364%, a 24-year high, while Fed minutes showed most officials still expect one more hike. AI chips fell after an OpenAI revenue scare, Brent climbed to $104.72, and SpaceX's spectrum purchase knocked about 9% off the US telecom giants.
